head: AwesomeComics comic reader for iPad turns pages like paper
dek: AwesomeComics is a new free comic reader for iPad: pages curl under your finger, landscape shows a two-page spread with a spine, and Guided View moves panel by panel. It reads your own CBZ, CBR and PDF files.
details: It came out on 3 November from Hrvoje Gjurin and doesn't sell comics. Your collection sits in longboxes by publisher and series, with manga right-to-left and webtoon scrolling, plus a reading journal. Pro (5.99 euros a year with a 7-day trial, or 14.99 euros once) adds home servers like Komga, Kavita and calibre-web, iCloud sync and more share cards. No account, no ads, no tracking.
where: iPad, App Store, free with optional Pro
means: If you keep comic files and want them to feel more like printed issues on your iPad, this is a free way to read them.
todo: Get it from the App Store and add your own comic files; Pro is only needed for home servers and sync.
